content:
**issue #509 addendum — the golden suite was SKIPPING in CI; abbreviated sha is read as a ref name**

**Actor:** claude-opus-5 (agente)
**Fuente:** issue #509 / PR #562
**Supersede:** the "RESIDUAL" paragraph of the earlier #509 record (rec saved same session) — the
skip is no longer the CI path.

The first CI run on PR #562 was all green and reported `# skipped 13`: the ENTIRE
brain-promote.golden.test.mjs suite — the acceptance test for the ticket — never executed. A
full checkout skips 0 (the one pre-existing skip, copyManaged, does not trigger off-root).

CAUSE: CI's local-checks job checks out at depth 1, so the oracle commit be2d143 is absent, and
the suite's fallback `git fetch --no-tags --depth=2 origin be2d143` FAILS with
"fatal: couldn't find remote ref be2d143". An ABBREVIATED sha is read as a REF NAME by git fetch;
it is not resolved as an object. The full 40-char sha works and takes ~1s:
`git fetch --no-tags --depth=2 origin be2d143e6cb62748369ba2f1a11425845eeeebaf`.

MEASURED, not reasoned: `git clone --depth 1 --branch <branch> https://github.com/csrinaldi/brain`
into a temp dir, confirmed `git cat-file -e be2d143^{commit}` fails there, then ran the suite —
13/13 pass with the full sha, 13/13 skip with the abbreviation. CI after the fix: 3262 pass,
0 fail, 0 skipped.

GENERAL LESSON, worth more than the bug: a skipped test and a passing test are the SAME COLOUR on
the PR page and in the check-run conclusion. The only signal that distinguished them was the
`# skipped` count in the job log. Any test that guards its own environment with `{ skip: ... }`
needs its skip count read at least once in the environment it is supposed to protect — otherwise
"CI is green" means "CI ran nothing", which is this repo's own
evidence-reader-empty-on-failure / red-proof-blind anti-pattern at the harness level.
